name: Karma
title: the Enlightened One

Q.name: Inner Flame
Q.description: Karma fires a blast of energy, dealing 60/110/160/210/260 + 0.7×AP magic damage to the first target hit and surrounding enemies, and Slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds.
Q.summary: Karma sends forth a ball of spirit energy that explodes and deals damage upon hitting an enemy unit. Mantra Bonus: In addition to the explosion, Mantra increases the destructive power of her Inner Flame, creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.

W.name: Focused Resolve
W.description: Karma tethers herself to a champion or jungle monster, dealing 40/65/90/115/140 + 0.45×AP magic damage and revealing them for 2s. If the tether remains unbroken, the target takes 40/65/90/115/140 + 0.45×AP magic damage again and is Rooted for 1.6/1.7/1.8/1.9/2s.
W.summary: Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy, dealing damage and revealing them. If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted and damaged again. Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.

E.name: Inspire
E.description: Karma grants an allied champion 80/130/180/230/280 + 0.6×AP Shield for 2.5s and 40% Move Speed for 2s.
E.summary: Karma summons a protective shield that absorbs incoming damage and increases the Move Speed of the protected ally. Mantra Bonus: Energy radiates out from her target, strengthening the initial shield and applying Inspire to nearby allied champions.

R.name: Mantra
R.description: Karma empowers her next Ability used within 8 seconds. Inner Flame: Deals an additional 40/100/160 + 0.3×AP magic damage and leaves behind a circle of flame, Slowing enemies and dealing an additional 40/130/220 + 0.5×AP magic damage.Focused Resolve: Karma will restore (17 + 0.01×AP) × 0.01 missing Health at the beginning and end of the tether, and Root for 0.5/0.75/1s longer.Inspire: Karma shields her target for 45/85/125 + 0.45×AP more Shield, and also shields allies near her target, granting them (45/85/125 + 0.45×AP) × 1 Shield and 15% Move Speed.
R.summary: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.

Passive.name: Gathering Fire
Passive.description: Karma's damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra.
Passive.summary: Karma's damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Karma is a poke mage who plays support, mid or top, using Mantra from level 1 to empower Inner Flame, Focused Resolve or Inspire. She bullies lanes with long-range area poke and gives her team shields and move speed in fights.
strengths: Mantra is available at level 1, so her empowered Inner Flame gives some of the strongest early poke in the game.
Gathering Fire lowers Mantra's cooldown each time she damages enemies, so she gets to empower abilities often.
Inspire gives an ally a shield and 40% move speed, which works for both engage and disengage; empowered, it shields the whole team.
Focused Resolve roots a target who doesn't break the tether, and with Mantra it roots longer and heals her.
Flexible: she can play support, mid or top and build damage or utility.
weaknesses: Falls off late: her poke loses value as enemies build health and resistances.
Her only hard CC is the W root, which enemies can break by walking out of the tether.
Squishy and immobile apart from Inspire's move speed.
Inner Flame stops on the first target hit, so minions block her poke.
Weak against hard engage once she has used E.

curve.lvl1: strong – Mantra Q poke from level 1 wins early trades
curve.lvl2: strong – Q slow then W tether gives a root setup
curve.lvl3: strong – E shield and move speed protect her ally in trades
curve.lvl6: good – Mantra gains ranks, but she gets no new ability
curve.items: weak – first item: Moonstone Renewer or Shurelya's Battlesong for support; Malignance or Luden's Companion in mid
curve.late: okay – keeps utility, but her damage and poke fall off

profile.curveNote: Karma is strongest early, with Mantra-empowered abilities from level 1. She wants to win lane with poke and is weaker later.
profile.waveClear: Good: Mantra Q clears waves from range.
profile.sustain: Okay: Mantra W heals her based on missing HP.

keyAbilities.trading: Q (Inner Flame) with Mantra for poke
keyAbilities.engage: W (Focused Resolve) root on a target who can't escape the tether
keyAbilities.escape: E (Inspire) shield and move speed to escape or engage
keyAbilities.answers: None. Karma has no spell shield or dodge.

Passive.notes: Gathering Fire: her damaging abilities lower Mantra's cooldown.

Q.answer: Dodge sideways, stand behind minions, or block with a projectile block.
Q.notes: Inner Flame: a missile that explodes on the first target hit, slowing nearby enemies; Mantra adds a burning circle.

W.answer: Walk out of tether range before it ends; Cleanse/QSS removes the root.
W.notes: Focused Resolve: a point-and-click tether that roots after a short time if not broken.

E.notes: Inspire: a shield and move speed on an ally.

R.notes: Mantra: empowers her next Q, W or E.

profile.windowAgainst: Karma's window is when Mantra and Inspire are both on cooldown: she has no shield or burst left. Break the W tether by walking away, and fight her later in the game.
checks: Does Karma use Mantra Q to poke the lane when she can?
Does Karma keep Inspire to protect an ally from engage?
Does the enemy walk out of the W tether before it roots?
